definitions.explanation: Containers or vessels made from clay that are fired at relatively low temperatures, typically without glazing. In archaeology, refers to ancient pottery artifacts.

examples.japanese: {考古学者|こうこがくしゃ}が{古|ふる}い{土器|どき}を{発見|はっけん}した。
{縄文|じょうもん}{土器|どき}は{日本|にほん}の{古代|こだい}{文化|ぶんか}を{示|しめ}している。
examples.english: Jomon pottery shows ancient Japanese culture.

examples.japanese: {博物館|はくぶつかん}で{土器|どき}の{展示|てんじ}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw the pottery exhibition at the museum.

notes:
HISTORICAL TYPES:
・{縄文|じょうもん}{土器|どき} (Jomon pottery - ca. 14,000-300 BCE)
・{弥生|やよい}{土器|どき} (Yayoi pottery - ca. 300 BCE-300 CE)

RELATED TERMS:
・{陶器|とうき} (ceramic; glazed pottery)
・{焼|や}き{物|もの} (pottery - general term)
・{粘土|ねんど} (clay)
